title: Lagos Return Rate Governance & Quality Review
investigation: Why is return rate increasing in Lagos?

facts: Lagos return rate reached 7.2% in July
Home Appliances category accounted for 68.4% of total returned units
observations: Surulere Hub experienced elevated return volume following transit packaging shifts.

management_decision: Require mandatory cashier return-reason tagging at POS and pause inventory replenishment on top 3 returned appliance SKUs.

title: Abuja Commercial Gross Margin Restoration
investigation: Why did gross profit margin collapse in Abuja?

facts: Gross profit margin dropped from 24.5% to 18.2% in Abuja
observations: Uncontrolled store-level markdowns eroded unit profit realization.

management_decision: Enforce a 12% promotional discount depth ceiling and require VP approval for markdowns >15%.
